scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Bwah hah hah~!
That look in your eyes~!
Those are definitely the eyes
of a lonely male bachelor.
I'm almost 100 percent sure
you got ditched at the altar.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
哇哈哈~！
你眼中的那抹光芒~！
那绝对是孤独单身汉的眼神。
我几乎百分之百确定，
你被新娘在婚礼上甩了。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Bwah hah hah~!
That look in your eyes~!
They're just filled with the
pain of an old maid--!
Couldn't rope some poor guy
into marriage, huh?
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
哇哈哈~！
你眼中的那抹光芒~！
那分明是充满怨念的老处女——！
没能把哪个倒霉蛋骗进婚姻，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
You look awfully depressed...
Lucky for you, I could care
less about happy people...
It's the humans in despair
that I take an interest in.
Hahahahahahah~!
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
你看起来郁闷极了...
幸好，我对快乐的人毫无兴趣...
只有陷入绝望的人类，
才会引起我的注意。
哈哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
HHAHAHAHA~!
Oooooh...Hee hee~
I'd be more sympathetic if,
you know, I weren't a creature
of darkness.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
哈哈哈哈~！
噢噢噢...嘿嘿~
要是我不是黑暗生物，
我或许会更同情你一些。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
I sense that you carry a
tiresome burden...
If I'm not wrong, you're
a married man, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
我感觉到你背负着沉重的负担...
如果我没看错的话，
你是个已婚男人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
I sense that you carry a
tiresome burden...
If I'm not wrong, you're
a married woman, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
我感觉到你背负着沉重的负担...
如果我没看错的话，
你是个已婚女人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Let me ask you one thing.
Are you happy to be married?
Forget about responsibilities,
romance and all that other junk
for now.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
让我问你一件事。
你结婚后快乐吗？
先别管什么责任、浪漫
和其他那些无聊的东西。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
I mean, can just one single
person really bring you all that
happiness? I know all about how
special weddings and the magic
of love is supposed to be, but...
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
我的意思是，真的只有一个人
能给你带来那么多幸福吗？
我知道婚礼有多特别，
也知道爱情有多神奇，但是...

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
At the end of the day, you and
your partner fight, and you feel
totally totally miserable.
...all because of HER.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
到头来，你和伴侣争吵，
感到无比无比痛苦。
...全是因为她。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
At the end of the day, you and
your partner fight, and you feel
totally totally miserable.
...all because of HIM.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
到头来，你和伴侣争吵，
感到无比无比痛苦。
...全是因为他。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Yes, it's your destiny to find me
here. We all make mistakes...
Even if you promised everlasting
love, even if you made a vow...
I can free you from that prison
of matrimony.
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
是的，你的命运就是在这里遇见我。
我们都会犯错...
即使你许下了永恒的誓言，
即使你立下了承诺...
我也能把你从婚姻的牢笼中解放出来。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
It's simple if you look at
marriage as a contract...a
contract that ends with 'till
death do we part.' Here in
Niflheim, it's easy to use
that little loophole...
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
如果你把婚姻看作一份契约...
一份“直到死亡将我们分离”的契约。
在尼弗海姆，
利用那个小漏洞很容易...

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
*whispers*
^555555It's not like you're breaking^000000
^555555any promises, and it's not
like your wife will care if she
doesn't know... Don't you
want to be freed from her?^000000
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
*低语*
^555555你并没有违背^000000
^555555任何誓言，而且如果你妻子不知道，
她也不会介意的...你不渴望
从她身边解脱吗？^000000

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
*whispers*
^555555It's not like you're breaking^000000
^555555any promises. Hell, your husband
doesn't even have to know
about it... you deserve
real happiness, right?^000000
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
*低语*
^555555你并没有违背^000000
^555555任何誓言。天哪，你丈夫甚至
不需要知道这件事...你值得
拥有真正的幸福，对吧？^000000

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
You can have a brand new love
with a better person...
Wouldn't that be great...?
I can help you if you want...
I can make all of this happen!
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
你可以和一个更好的人
开始一段全新的恋情...
那不是很棒吗...？
如果你愿意，我可以帮你...
我可以让你的一切成真！

scripts.text: No thanks, I am happy.
scripts.translation: 不用了，我很幸福。

scripts.text: Yes, please do.
scripts.translation: 是的，请帮我。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Hmpf~! You must still be
fascinated with the silly
notion of eternal love. Well,
if you think you're happy,
then I'll have nothing
to do with you--!
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
哼~！你肯定还沉迷于
永恒爱情这种愚蠢的观念。
好吧，如果你觉得幸福，
那我就和你没什么好说的了——！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Good, good...
Now all you have to do is give
me what I want in exchange...
Just 2,500,000 zeny and...*cough!*
^666666An eensy piece of your soul.^000000
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
很好，很好...
现在你只需要给我想要的东西作为交换...
只要2,500,000 Zeny，还有...*咳！*
^666666你灵魂的一小片碎片。^000000

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
After that, it's the carefree
single's life. All you have to
do is say the word...
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
之后，就是无忧无虑的单身生活了。
你只需要说一声...

scripts.text: ...Give me some time to think.
scripts.translation: ……让我再考虑一下。

scripts.text: Any price will do, give me a divorce right now!
scripts.translation: 多少钱都行，现在就给我办离婚！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
I understand. But if you think
about anything, think about
your wife's nagging, and
how great it would be to
finally free yourself of the
old ball and chain~
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
我理解。不过如果你在想什么，
就想想你妻子的唠叨，
以及终于摆脱这个
累赘的球链该有多好~

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
I understand. But if you think
about anything, think about
how horrible your husband is,
and what a relief it would
be to be rid of that crumbum~
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
我理解。不过如果你在想什么，
就想想你丈夫有多糟糕，
以及摆脱那个废物该有多轻松~

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Excellent choice~
Let's get started right
away! This may take some
time, but it's better than
being hopelessly married
^FF0000for the rest of your life.^000000
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
极好的选择~
我们马上开始！这可能需要一些时间，
但总比绝望地
^FF0000过完余生要结婚^000000好。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Hmmm...I did tell you to bring
2,500,000 zeny, right?
No one else in this world can
offer this kind of freedom...
You can't put a price on
peace of mind, can you?
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
嗯……我告诉过你要带
2,500,000 Zeny，对吧？
这世上没人能提供这种自由...
心灵的平静是无价的，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Bwahhahahaha~!
Now you're free~!
Don't you feel so much
better now as a single?
Ah, bachelorhood...
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
哇哈哈哈哈哈~！
现在你自由了~！
作为单身汉，
你现在是不是感觉好多了？
啊，单身生活...
